para1: At Pulse, we believe that accessing reliable health information shouldn't come at the expense of your privacy. We're committed to being transparent about how information is collected, used, and protected.
para2: Pulse is designed to let you explore health information without creating an account or providing personal medical information.
para3: Depending on how you interact with our website, limited technical information may be processed by our hosting provider to operate and maintain the site.
para4: Any information collected through Pulse is intended to support website functionality, improve the user experience, and maintain the security and reliability of our services.
para5: Pulse may provide links to external healthcare websites and educational resources. These websites operate under their own privacy policies, and we encourage users to review them before sharing personal information.
para6: We aim to make trustworthy health information accessible while respecting your privacy. As Pulse continues to develop, we will update our privacy practices to reflect new features and services.
disclaimer: This privacy notice describes Pulse's current informational website and may change as additional features are introduced.
